messages.content: Use at most 32 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "you're" are allowed.) None of these punctuation marks may appear: [')']. Make your response end with "for your consideration.". Include a title at the top. If you include a title, make the title line start with "# ".

Write cover letters for a job application. It is for an assistant professor position. Use at least 33 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "don't" count as part of the word.) Do not add extra text after "for your consideration."; end the response with it. Include a title at the top. Use "# " at the beginning of the title line. Do not use any of these punctuation marks: [')'].
